title: Count Through &self
goal: record() takes &self and must still increment a counter. Pick the field type that allows it.
hints: &self forbids assignment to plain fields - E0594. The mutability has to live INSIDE the field.
Cell trades references for whole-value get/set - which is why it can never panic.
explanation: A &self method can't assign to a plain u32 field (E0594) - shared means read-only, by default. Cell<u32> moves the mutability inside the field: set() and get() copy whole values in and out through the shared reference, no guards, no panics possible. This is interior mutability's gentlest form - for Copy types, Cell is all you need, and the API stays &self as callers expect of a counter.
